verdict.rationale: Salesforce offers the building blocks—an official MCP server and CLI (salesforce-probe-3, salesforce-probe-4), API access (salesforce-docs-7), Agentforce agents spanning the deal cycle (salesforce-docs-21), and automatic email/event syncing (salesforce-docs-8)—but there is no concrete documentation or example showing an agent actually reading email/meeting signals and updating Opportunity stage/next-steps fields via the API or MCP server. missing for 10: a documented workflow or example (first-party or hands-on) of an agent parsing email/meeting content and writing stage/next-step updates to Opportunity records, and independent corroboration that this works in practice.
